title: 第87章 反探监视洞悉阴谋第86章 长老窥探暗中监视
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 后山夜色如墨，沉谧死寂。
荒坟残碑在月影下拉出斑驳狭长的黑影，枯草被夜风卷得簌簌轻响，本该萧瑟荒芜的山林，此刻却暗藏层层紧绷的杀机与窥探。无形无质的神念大网笼罩整片区域，细密如蛛网、禁锢似铁笼，将小院的方寸天地牢牢锁死，每一缕灵气流转、每一丝人声动静，都被精准捕捉、尽数收纳。
四方密林深处，四道黑衣身影蛰伏不动，与夜色草木融为一体。他们气息死寂、神魂内敛，摒弃了一切生灵杂念，如同四尊冰冷的望石像，昼夜不倦地盯着院中那道静坐的清瘦身影。作为宗门顶尖暗卫，他们深谙隐匿窥探之道，自信这一套由金丹长老亲自布设的监视罗网，足以封锁一切异动，哪怕是半步金丹的强者坐镇此处，也绝难察觉分毫破绽。
小院青石蒲团之上，林寂双目轻阖，身姿静定如松，周身温润的正统灵气缓缓周天流转，气息平稳规整，毫无半分异常。在外层暗卫的探查视野中，他自始至终都是一副潜心闭关、安分蛰伏的模样，褪去了此前颠覆道统的凌厉锋芒，安静得毫无威胁，仿佛彻底被宗门的威压震慑，收敛了所有异心与图谋。
可唯有林寂自己知晓，这份平和安分，全然是刻意伪装的表象。
自昨夜察觉神念窥探的那一刻起，他便已然洞悉了整场监视布局，心中冷笑不止。青玄宗高层自以为手段缜密、掌控全局，以暗卫围堵、神念锁域的方式将他拿捏在手，殊不知这张刻意布下的监视大网，恰恰成了他反向溯源、探查宗门隐秘的最佳通道。
朽道真解最擅勘破虚妄、溯源追根，世间一切刻意伪装、暗藏阴暗的算计，在逆道本源面前，皆无所遁形。
方才与苏清砚的对话，他刻意压低声线、把控气息波动，精准避开表层神念的捕捉范围，既让暗卫无从窥探谈话内容，又营造出寻常闲谈、无忧无谋的假象，彻底麻痹暗处监视之人的心神。待苏清砚踏月离去、身形消失在山林雾气之中后，小院彻底归于寂静，林寂终于收起所有伪装，悄然开启了反向探查的布局。
他依旧保持盘膝静坐的姿态，睫毛未颤、身躯未动，甚至连周身灵气流转的节奏都未曾更改，完美维持着闭关苦修的假象。唯独神魂深处，一缕极致凝练、近乎透明的朽道本源悄然苏醒，无声无息扩散开来。
这缕朽气与寻常杀伐凌厉的灰色朽气截然不同，无半分攻击性、无半分波动外泄，极致柔和、极致隐秘，如同融入天地的微尘，顺着四周铺展的神念网纹路，丝丝缕缕、缓慢有序地向外蔓延渗透。
寻常修士的神念探查，皆是主动外放、捕捉外物，直白且刚硬，极易被高阶修士察觉反制。而林寂的朽道溯源，却是顺势而为、借网潜行，依托对手布设的神念脉络反向渗透，不冲破、不触碰、不激怒对方的神念壁垒，完美规避一切探查预警。
外层密林之中，值守的暗卫依旧死死紧盯小院，神念匀速扫过整片区域，未曾察觉到半分异常。在他们的感知里，整片后山灵气安稳、波动平和，林寂的修行状态一成不变，没有任何异动值得警惕。他们全然不知，自己引以为傲的隐匿神念，早已沦为对方借力探源的桥梁，自身的神魂轨迹、站位方位、气息频率，尽数被院中的少年精准洞悉、牢牢掌控。
朽气丝丝蔓延，顺着四道暗卫的探查神念逐一溯源，精准锁定四人的藏身方位。
东侧古木枝干上，暗卫气息沉冷、心神紧绷，擅长远距离神念锁定；西侧乱石堆后，暗卫敛息术最为精湛，肉身气息完全与山石相融，负责死角补位探查；南北两处暗卫攻守兼备，随时准备应对突发异动、拦截擅离后山的林寂。四人分工明确、配合默契，轮换无隙，数十年的配合历练，让这组暗卫的监视体系堪称无懈可击。
林寂心神沉静，将四人的站位、能力、值守规律尽数收录心底，眼底掠过一抹淡漠冷意。
这般精密完善的监视布局，绝非临时起意、随意排布，必然是玄风长老精心部署、层层安排，足以见得宗门高层对他的忌惮之深、防备之重。他们根本不信他会安分蛰伏，哪怕数日毫无异动，依旧不肯放松半分警惕，执意要将他锁死在后山，静待可乘之机。
但这仅仅只是表层的监视布局，并非林寂真正想要探寻的核心隐秘。
他真正的目标，从来不是这四名无名暗卫，而是躲在主峰大殿、幕后操盘的三位金丹长老，是他们刻意隐瞒、死守万年的深层阴谋。
心念微动，林寂不再停留于表层溯源，凝练的朽道本源顺着四道暗卫的神念脉络继续向上延伸、层层穿透。
暗卫的神念并非无根之水，每一次探查外放，都会与主事长老的核心神念隐隐呼应、建立羁绊。这是宗门暗卫体系的专属规制，方便高层实时掌控暗卫动向、同步探查情报、远程调度指挥。而这份专属羁绊，恰恰成了最大的破绽。
朽气顺着微弱的神念羁绊，突破山林阻隔、穿透云雾层叠，一路向上溯源，直奔主峰凌霄大殿的方向。
大殿之外的灵玉镇道纹、隔绝屏障，能隔绝寻常修士的神魂探查、灵力窥探，却隔绝不了朽道逆天之能。这些被天道规则加持、被宗门灵力固化的防御屏障，本质依旧是正统伪道的产物，在朽道本源面前，如同薄纸一般脆弱。
无声无息之间，一缕微不可察的朽气穿透层层屏障，悄然潜入肃穆威严的凌霄大殿之中，隐匿在殿顶灵雾之间，静静聆听着殿内的一举一动、一字一句。
此刻的凌霄大殿，依旧灯火长明、气氛沉凝。
三名金丹长老端坐原位，手中握着刚刚汇总成册的监视玉简，反复翻阅核查，神色凝重肃穆。连日的监视毫无收获，让三人心中的忌惮愈发深重，心绪也愈发复杂紧绷。
玄风长老指尖划过玉简上平淡无奇的记录，眸中寒芒翻涌，语气带着几分沉郁与不解：“连日监视，终日无措。此子闭门不出、不言不语、不妄不躁，举止规矩得无可挑剔，完全找不到半分逾矩破绽。越是如此，我心中越是不安。”
“寻常少年一朝崛起、名震宗门，必然心高气傲、急于证明自身，就算刻意隐忍，也难免有疏漏破绽。可林寂的隐忍太过完美，完美得刻意，完美得诡异，仿佛早已预知我们的所有部署，刻意配合演戏。”
青玄长老缓缓颔首，眉头紧锁，苍老的眼底藏着深深的忧虑与忌惮，沉声道：“老夫活了近百载，亲历数代天骄更迭，从未见过心性、城府、定力如此恐怖的少年。他年纪轻轻，却能做到荣辱不惊、喜怒不形于色，洞悉万古真相却隐忍不发，手握逆道力量却深藏不露，这般心智，若是任由成长，未来整片南疆修行界，无人能制。”
“最可怕的是，他的认知早已超脱当代所有修士。他知晓功法残缺、天道收灵、万古饲局，知晓我们历代高层死守的所有隐秘。这般认知，已经不是单纯的道途偏差，而是足以颠覆整个修行秩序的恐怖底牌。”
李千绝指尖轻叩石桌，发出沉闷的轻响，打破殿内沉寂，语气冰冷果决：“知晓真相，便是最大的罪孽。”
“我青玄宗万年基业，乃至整片天下的修行秩序，皆建立在正统圆满、天道无错的基础之上。一旦这层虚假壁垒被彻底撕碎，所有修士的道心都会崩塌，修行体系会彻底瓦解，届时天地大乱、修士无途，众生皆陷入绝望浩劫。”
“我辈身居高位，执掌宗门秩序、维系天地安稳，哪怕知晓正统有缺、天道藏局，也必须死守这份虚假。不是我等甘愿为虎作伥，而是唯有维持伪道秩序，才能维系世间修行体系的平稳运转。”
隐匿在殿内灵雾中的朽气，将这番话语一字不落尽数收录，传回后山小院林寂的神魂之中。
林寂静坐不动，心底却骤然掀起一阵波澜，随即化为彻骨寒凉。
他此前只猜测，宗门高层隐瞒真相、维稳骗局，是为了固守自身权位、贪恋手中权势，却从未想到，他们竟有着这般自欺欺人的扭曲认知。
在他们眼中，明明是天道收割众生、伪道葬送修士的残酷死局，明明是万古不息的腐朽屠戮，却被他们当成了“维系秩序、安稳众生”的必然牺牲。他们明知一代代天骄会朽败陨落、无数修士会白白送死，却依旧选择闭口不言、刻意维稳，将鲜活的同门后辈，当成维系虚假太平的祭品。
愚昧的修士是可悲的，而清醒却选择助纣为虐、以恶为善的掌权者，更是可恨至极。
殿内的谈话仍在继续，层层隐秘的阴谋，被逐层剥开、展露真相。
青玄长老轻叹一声，语气带着几分无奈与沉重：“上古天道异变之后，万法残缺、道途崩坏，圆满大道彻底断绝。我辈后人已然无力回天，若是揭穿真相、打破伪道，世间修士失去修行依托、道心溃散，只会引发更大的浩劫。与其让众生绝望崩毁、乱世四起，不如让众人顺道修行、安稳一生，哪怕最终朽败陨落，也能维系万古秩序不断。”
“这是历代高层默认的铁律，也是我们不得不背负的罪孽。为了万古道统存续，必须牺牲一代代修士的道途与性命，稳住这片天地的修行秩序。”
这番话看似冠冕堂皇、心怀苍生，实则是极致的懦弱与虚伪。
他们畏惧天道神威、无力抗衡万古棋局，便选择屈服妥协、助纣为虐，用万千后辈的性命与道途，换取自身的安稳权位，换取宗门表面的兴盛平和。不敢逆天破局，便只能牺牲众生、维稳虚假。
content_en:
The night in the back mountain is as dark as ink, silent and dead.
The ruined tombs and monuments cast long and mottled black shadows under the moonlight, and the withered grass rustled softly in the night wind. The mountain forest that should have been desolate and desolate was now hiding layers of intense murderous intent and prying eyes. The invisible and qualityless web of spiritual thoughts covers the entire area, as fine as a spider web and as imprisoned as an iron cage, tightly locking the square inch of the small courtyard. Every ray of spiritual energy flowing, every human voice and movement are accurately captured and contained.
Deep in the dense forest in all directions, four figures in black were dormant and motionless, blending into the night vegetation. Their breaths were dead, their souls were introverted, and they had abandoned all distracting thoughts of life. They were like four cold stone statues, staring day and night at the thin figure sitting quietly in the courtyard. As the top secret guards of the sect, they are well versed in the art of concealment and spying. They are confident that the surveillance net set up by the Jindan elders is enough to block all abnormal movements. Even if a half-step Jindan strong man is sitting here, it will be difficult to detect any flaws.
On the bluestone futon in the small courtyard, Lin Ji's eyes were lightly closed, her figure was as calm as a pine tree, the warm orthodox aura around her body slowly circulated around the sky, and her breath was steady and regular, without any abnormality. In the probing field of view of the outer secret guards, he had always looked like he was concentrating on seclusion and dormant. He had lost the sharp edge that had subverted the orthodoxy before, and was quiet and without any threat. It was as if he was completely frightened by the pressure of the sect and restrained all his dissent and plots.
But only Lin Ji knew that this peace and tranquility was completely a deliberately disguised appearance.
From the moment he noticed the prying eyes of his spiritual mind last night, he had already understood the entire surveillance layout, and he couldn't help but sneer in his heart. The senior officials of the Qingxuan Sect thought they had meticulous methods and were in control of the overall situation. They used secret guards to surround him and his spiritual thoughts to lock the area. However, they did not know that this deliberately laid surveillance network became the best channel for him to trace back to his origins and explore the secrets of the sect.
The True Interpretation of the Decaying Dao is the best at uncovering illusions and tracing back to the source. All the deliberately disguised and dark schemes in the world have no way of hiding in the face of the origin of the counter-dao.
In the conversation with Su Qingyan just now, he deliberately lowered his voice, controlled the fluctuations of his breath, and accurately avoided the capture range of his superficial spiritual thoughts. This not only prevented the secret guards from spying on the content of the conversation, but also created the illusion of ordinary chatting and carefree, completely paralyzing the minds of those watching in the dark. After Su Qingyan left on the moon and disappeared into the mist of the mountains and forests, the small courtyard became completely silent. Lin Ji finally put away all disguises and quietly started the reverse exploration plan.
He still maintained a posture of sitting cross-legged in meditation, his eyelashes did not tremble, his body did not move, and even the rhythm of the spiritual energy flowing around his body did not change, perfectly maintaining the illusion of seclusion and ascetic cultivation. Only deep in the soul, a ray of extremely condensed and almost transparent origin of the decayed path quietly awakened and spread silently.
This wisp of decaying energy is completely different from the ordinary gray decaying energy that is aggressive and aggressive. It has no aggressiveness and no fluctuations to leak out. It is extremely soft and extremely secretive. It is like the dust that blends into the heaven and earth. It follows the lines of the spiritual network spreading around it, slowly and orderly spreading outward.
Ordinary monks' spiritual explorations are all about actively releasing and capturing foreign objects. They are straightforward and rigid, and can easily be detected and counterattacked by high-level monks. However, Lin Ji's way of tracing the origin of the rotten path was to follow the trend, sneak through the network, and rely on the opponent's spiritual veins to penetrate reversely. He did not break through, touch, or anger the opponent's spiritual barriers, and perfectly avoided all detection and warnings.
In the outer dense forest, the secret guards on duty were still keeping a close eye on the small courtyard. Their spiritual thoughts swept across the entire area at a constant speed, not noticing any abnormalities. In their perception, the spiritual energy of the entire back mountain was stable and the fluctuations were peaceful. Lin Ji's cultivation state remained unchanged, and there was no abnormality that warranted vigilance. They had no idea that the hidden spiritual thoughts they were proud of had already become a bridge for the other party to use their strength to explore the source. The trajectory of their spiritual soul, their position, and the frequency of their breath were all accurately understood and firmly controlled by the young people in the courtyard.
The decaying energy spreads in threads, tracing the origins one by one along the probing thoughts of the four secret guards, and accurately locking the hiding position of the four people.
On the branches of ancient trees on the east side, the secret guards have a cold aura and tense mind, and are good at locking in long-distance spiritual thoughts; behind the pile of rocks on the west side, the secret guards have the most exquisite breathing skills, their physical aura is completely integrated with the rocks, and are responsible for filling in and exploring blind spots; the secret guards in the north and south are both offensive and defensive, ready to deal with sudden changes and intercept Lin Ji who leaves the back mountain without permission. The four people have a clear division of labor, a tacit understanding of cooperation, seamless rotation, and decades of joint experience, making the surveillance system of this group of secret guards impeccable.
Lin Ji's mind was calm, and he took all the positions, abilities, and duty rules of the four people into his mind, and there was a hint of indifference and coldness in his eyes.
Such a sophisticated and complete surveillance layout was by no means a temporary and haphazard arrangement. It must have been carefully deployed and arranged by Elder Xuanfeng, which was enough to show how deeply the sect's senior officials feared and guarded against him. They didn't believe that he would lie dormant peacefully. Even if there was no movement for several days, they still refused to relax their vigilance and insisted on locking him up in the back mountain, waiting for an opportunity.
But this is only the surface surveillance layout, not the core secret that Lin Ji really wants to explore.
His real target has never been these four nameless secret guards, but the three Jindan elders who are hiding in the main peak hall and operating behind the scenes. It is a deep conspiracy that they have deliberately concealed and clung to for thousands of years.
With a slight thought in his mind, Lin Ji no longer stayed at the surface to trace the source. The condensed origin of the rotten path continued to extend upwards and penetrated layer by layer along the spiritual veins of the four secret guards.
The secret guard's spiritual thoughts are not rootless water. Every time they are explored and released, they will faintly echo and establish a bond with the core spiritual thoughts of the elder in charge. This is the exclusive regulation of the sect's secret guard system, which facilitates senior management to control the secret guard's movements in real time, synchronize intelligence exploration, and remotely dispatch and command. And this exclusive bond has become the biggest flaw.
Following the weak fetters of spiritual thoughts, the decaying energy breaks through the barriers of mountains and forests, penetrates layers of clouds and mist, traces its way upwards, and goes straight to the direction of the main peak, Lingxiao Hall.
The spiritual jade Dao-holding patterns and isolation barriers outside the main hall can isolate ordinary monks from the exploration of their souls and spiritual power, but they cannot isolate the power of the rotten path to defy the heavens. These defensive barriers, blessed by the rules of heaven and solidified by the spiritual power of the sect, are still essentially the products of the orthodox false Tao, and are as fragile as tissue paper in front of the origin of the rotten Tao.
Silently, a wisp of imperceptible decayed air penetrated the layers of barriers and quietly sneaked into the solemn and majestic Lingxiao Hall. It was hidden in the spiritual mist on the top of the hall, quietly listening to every move and word in the hall.
At this moment, the Lingxiao Hall was still brightly lit and the atmosphere was calm.
The three Jindan elders were sitting in their original positions, holding the surveillance jade slips that had just been compiled into a volume in their hands, looking through them repeatedly for verification, with solemn and solemn expressions. Days of surveillance yielded no results, making the three of them increasingly fearful and emotionally complex.
Elder Xuanfeng's fingertips ran across the unremarkable records on the jade slip, his eyes filled with coldness, and his tone was a bit gloomy and puzzled: "I have been monitoring him for days and days, and I am at a loss all day long. This man stays behind closed doors, keeps silent, does not act rashly, and behaves impeccably. There is no trace of any violation of the rules. The more this happens, the more uneasy I feel."
"When an ordinary young man rises up and becomes famous in his sect, he must be arrogant and eager to prove himself. Even if he deliberately forbears, there will inevitably be omissions and flaws. But Lin Ji's forbearance is so perfect, so perfect that it's so deliberate, so perfect that it's weird, as if he has already predicted all our plans and deliberately cooperates with the acting."
Elder Qingxuan nodded slowly, frowning, with deep worry and fear hidden in his old eyes, and said solemnly: "I have lived for nearly a hundred years, and have witnessed the succession of several generations of geniuses. I have never seen a young man with such terrifying character, character, and determination. He At such a young age, he is able to remain calm about honor and disgrace, remain indifferent to emotions and emotions, understand the truth of eternity but not reveal it, and hold the power of rebellion but hide it deeply. If such a mind is allowed to grow, no one will be able to control it in the entire Southern Xinjiang cultivation world in the future. "
"The most frightening thing is that his knowledge has already surpassed that of all contemporary monks. He knows the incompleteness of martial arts, the harvesting of heavenly spirits, and the eternal trap. He knows all the secrets that our senior leaders have guarded for generations. This kind of knowledge is no longer a simple deviation in the path, but a terrifying trump card that can subvert the entire order of practice."
Li Qianjue's fingertips tapped lightly on the stone table, making a dull sound, breaking the silence in the hall. His tone was cold and decisive: "Knowing the truth is the greatest sin."
"Our Qingxuan Sect's ten thousand-year foundation, and even the entire world's cultivation order, are based on the perfection of orthodoxy and the infallibility of heaven's way. Once this layer of false barriers is completely torn apart, the Taoist hearts of all monks will collapse, the cultivation system will completely collapse, and then the world will be in chaos, the monks will have no way out, and all living beings will fall into despair and catastrophe."
"We are in a high position, responsible for the order of the sect and maintaining the stability of the world. Even if we know that the orthodoxy is lacking and the heaven and earth are hidden, we must stick to this falsehood. It is not that we are willing to help the tiger, but only by maintaining the order of the false order can the smooth operation of the world's practice system be maintained."
The decaying energy hidden in the spiritual mist in the temple collected these words word for word and transmitted them back to Lin Ji's soul in the small courtyard behind the mountain.
Lin Jingjing could not sit still, but a wave of waves suddenly arose in her heart, which then turned into a bone-chilling chill.
He had only guessed before that the sect's senior officials concealed the truth and maintained stability in order to cling to their own positions and covet the power in their hands, but he never thought that they had such a distorted understanding of self-deception.
In their eyes, it is clearly a cruel death situation in which the gods harvest sentient beings and the false ones bury the monks. It is obviously a rotten massacre that lasts for eternity, but they regard it as an inevitable sacrifice to "maintain order and stabilize all sentient beings." They knew that generations of geniuses would decay and fall, and countless monks would die in vain, but they still chose to keep silent and deliberately maintain stability, using their living descendants as sacrifices to maintain false peace.
Ignorant monks are pathetic, but sober people in power who choose to help evil and do good for evil are even more hateful.
The conversation in the palace continued, and the layers of hidden conspiracies were peeled back layer by layer to reveal the truth.
Elder Qingxuan sighed softly, with a hint of helplessness and heaviness in his tone: "After the ancient changes in the way of heaven, all methods were incomplete, the paths collapsed, and the perfect way was completely cut off. The descendants of our generation are already helpless. If the truth is exposed and the false way is broken, the world will be destroyed. If monks lose the support for their practice and their Taoist hearts collapse, it will only lead to greater catastrophes. Rather than letting all living beings collapse in despair and chaos, it is better to let everyone follow the Tao and live a stable life. Even if they eventually fall, they can maintain the order of eternity. "
"This is the iron law that has been tacitly acknowledged by the senior officials of all generations, and it is also a sin that we have to bear. For the eternal survival of the Taoist tradition, we must sacrifice the paths and lives of generations of monks to stabilize the order of practice in this world."
These words may seem high-sounding and have the common people in mind, but in fact they are the ultimate cowardice and hypocrisy.
They were afraid of the divine power of heaven and were unable to compete with the eternal chess game, so they chose to give in and help the evil tyrants. They exchanged the lives and paths of thousands of descendants for their own stable power and the prosperity and peace of the sect on the surface. If you don’t dare to defy nature and break the situation, you can only sacrifice all sentient beings and maintain the falsehood.
